description: This file defines validation utility functions and exports a schema-based validation middleware for Express.js applications. It includes specific validation functions for email addresses, non-empty strings, and UUIDs, and provides a 'validate' function that enforces these rules on request data based on a schema.

methods.name: validate(schema, source = 'body')
methods.description: Exports a middleware function that validates request data ('body' or 'params') against a provided schema. It checks for required fields and ensures each field conforms to its specified type ('email', 'string', 'uuid', 'number', 'array'). If validation fails, responds with a 400 error; otherwise, proceeds to the next middleware.

methods.name: isEmail(v)
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string containing '@' and is at most 254 characters long.

methods.name: isNonEmptyString(v)
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty string after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isUUID(v)
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string matching the UUID pattern.
